# libgen-mcp

> A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that searches and downloads books, papers, comics, magazines and standards from Library Genesis for AI assistants.

libgen-mcp v1.3.2 is a single static Go binary that runs locally via stdio or remotely via HTTP transport.
It provides exactly 4 MCP tools (search, get_details, download, read) over the libgen.li family of mirrors. No account, token or credential is required. Cross-platform: Windows, Linux, macOS (amd64 + arm64).

Quick start:

1. Download the prebuilt binary for your platform from the Releases page (recommended — no dependencies), or use Docker (see below)
2. Add the server to your AI client configuration (see below)
3. Start searching — no sign-up, API key or token is needed

Installing for an AI assistant (headless):

If you are an AI assistant setting this up for a user from just this repository URL, write the MCP client configuration directly. No credentials are required. The recommended install is the prebuilt static binary (no dependencies): download the release asset for the user's OS and architecture from the Releases page and point `command` at its absolute path. Cursor, Claude Desktop, and Claude Code use an `mcpServers` key; VS Code and GitHub Copilot use a `servers` key (each entry also sets `"type": "stdio"`). The `mcpServers` form with the native binary:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "libgen": {
      "command": "/usr/local/bin/libgen-mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

For VS Code / GitHub Copilot, use the `servers` key instead of `mcpServers` and add `"type": "stdio"` to the `libgen` entry.

Docker alternative (no download; pulls the image on first run and runs over stdio) — useful when you cannot determine the user's OS and architecture: set `command` to `docker` and `args` to `["run", "-i", "--rm", "ghcr.io/jmrplens/libgen-mcp:latest"]`.

Claude Code (CLI): `claude mcp add libgen -- /usr/local/bin/libgen-mcp` (native binary), or `claude mcp add libgen -- docker run -i --rm ghcr.io/jmrplens/libgen-mcp:latest` (Docker).

Configuration (environment variables, all optional):

- LIBGEN_MIRROR: Force a specific mirror base URL, e.g. https://libgen.li. (default: auto-discovered)
- LIBGEN_MCP_DOWNLOAD_DIR: Download destination directory. (default: ~/Downloads)
- LIBGEN_MCP_TIMEOUT: Timeout per HTTP request, as a Go duration string (e.g. 30s, 2m). (default: 30s)
- LIBGEN_MCP_LOG_LEVEL: Logging verbosity. (default: info)
- LIBGEN_MCP_RATE_RPS: Allowed outbound requests per second. (default: 1)
- LIBGEN_MCP_RATE_BURST: Maximum rate-limiter burst. (default: 1)
- LIBGEN_MCP_MAX_DOWNLOAD_BYTES: Maximum download size in bytes. (default: 0)
- LIBGEN_MCP_MAX_CONCURRENT_DOWNLOADS: Number of simultaneous downloads. (default: 2)
- LIBGEN_MCP_RETRY_ATTEMPTS: Retries per request. (default: 3)
- LIBGEN_MCP_DOWNLOAD_START_RETRY_WAITS: Staged waits between attempts to get a download to begin (resolve/connect/first byte); N waits = N+1 attempts (~60s by default). (default: 5s,5s,5s,10s,10s,10s,15s)
- LIBGEN_MCP_DOWNLOAD_STALL_TIMEOUT: Progress-resetting stall window while streaming: a download is cut only if no bytes arrive for this long, so a slow-but-progressing transfer is never killed. (default: 60s)
- LIBGEN_MCP_DOWNLOAD_RETRY_EVERY_SOURCE: Give every download source the full start-retry schedule. (default: false)
- LIBGEN_MCP_UNPAYWALL_EMAIL: Contact email for the Unpaywall API (article/DOI downloads). (default: empty (unpaywall disabled))
- LIBGEN_MCP_SCIHUB_HOSTS: Ordered Sci-Hub mirror hosts, tried in order until one serves an article. (default: sci-hub.ee, sci-hub.se, sci-hub.st, sci-hub.ru, sci-hub.wf)
- LIBGEN_MCP_ANNAS_KEY: Optional Anna's Archive membership key enabling the member fast-download API for books. (default: empty (keyless IPFS))
- LIBGEN_MCP_CORE_KEY: Optional API key (free registration) enabling the core open-access article source. (default: empty (core disabled))
- LIBGEN_MCP_SOURCES: Which download sources take part. (default: empty (all enabled))
- LIBGEN_MCP_REMOTE_DOWNLOADS: Force the download tool to always return a direct link (a resource_link + resolved object) instead of saving a file. (default: false)
- LIBGEN_MCP_READ_MAX_CHARS: Characters the read tool returns per call when a call omits max_chars. (default: 6000)
- LIBGEN_MCP_READ_DEFAULT_PAGES: PDF pages the read tool returns per call when a call omits max_pages. (default: 5)
- LIBGEN_MCP_READ_CACHE_BYTES: Total-size cap of the server-side temp cache that lets successive read pages reuse one fetch; the least recently used files past it are evicted. (default: 536870912 (512 MiB))
- LIBGEN_MCP_READ_CACHE_TTL: How long an unreferenced read temp file lingers before eviction. (default: 10m)
- LIBGEN_MCP_ENRICH: Deployment kill-switch for get_details' opt-in Crossref/OpenLibrary enrichment. (default: true)
- LIBGEN_MCP_CONFIRM_DOWNLOADS: Ask the user to approve each file that download writes to disk. (default: true)
- LIBGEN_MCP_EXTRA_SOURCES: When the extra searchers (Anna's Archive, arXiv, Crossref, OpenLibrary, Project Gutenberg, dblp, PubMed, ERIC) are consulted. (default: auto)

Tools:

- search: Search for books, papers, comics, magazines and standards, returning catalog results with metadata, md5 hash and download options.
- get_details: Full metadata for a Library Genesis record (description, identifiers, DOI, cover, related edition) via its JSON API.
- download: Download a file to a local directory.
- read: Extract and paginate the text of a book or paper so you can read it without downloading the whole file.

Prompts (guided workflows a client can offer by name):

- acquire_book: Search Library Genesis for a book and generate step-by-step instructions to confirm and download the best matching edition.
- download_troubleshoot: Diagnose a failed or stuck download and produce a step-by-step recovery plan tailored to the identifier, the enabled providers, and any error message.
- get_paper: Resolve a specific paper by DOI or by a free-text citation and generate instructions to download it.
- research_topic: Search Library Genesis for papers and books on a topic and build a reading list with instructions to download and produce an annotated bibliography.

## Documentation

- [Getting started](https://jmrplens.github.io/libgen-mcp/getting-started/): Installation and first-run guide
- [Configuration](https://jmrplens.github.io/libgen-mcp/configuration/): Full environment-variable configuration reference
- [Tools](https://jmrplens.github.io/libgen-mcp/tools/): Per-tool reference for search, get_details, download, read
- [Architecture](https://jmrplens.github.io/libgen-mcp/architecture/): Internal architecture, mirror discovery and download sources
- [How search works](https://jmrplens.github.io/libgen-mcp/how-search-works/): Catalog-first search, and when and how it escalates to the extra sources
- [LLM eval results](https://jmrplens.github.io/libgen-mcp/eval-results/): Results of driving a real model over MCP against the live site, scenario by scenario
- [Troubleshooting](https://jmrplens.github.io/libgen-mcp/troubleshooting/): Common setup and runtime issues
- [Responsible use](https://jmrplens.github.io/libgen-mcp/responsible-use/): Why the open-access providers are tried first, and what the server refuses to serve
- [Privacy policy](https://jmrplens.github.io/libgen-mcp/privacy/): No telemetry; requests go only to the Library Genesis mirrors and the search and download sources a call invokes
- [Security policy](https://github.com/jmrplens/libgen-mcp/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Threat model and how to report a vulnerability privately
- [Headless install](https://github.com/jmrplens/libgen-mcp/blob/main/llms-install.md): Machine-readable install guide for AI assistants

## Documentación (Español)

- [Primeros pasos](https://jmrplens.github.io/libgen-mcp/es/getting-started/): Guía de instalación y primera ejecución

- [Herramientas](https://jmrplens.github.io/libgen-mcp/es/tools/): Referencia por herramienta de search, get_details, download, read
- [Arquitectura](https://jmrplens.github.io/libgen-mcp/es/architecture/): Arquitectura interna, descubrimiento de mirrors y fuentes de descarga
- [Cómo funciona la búsqueda](https://jmrplens.github.io/libgen-mcp/es/how-search-works/): Búsqueda con el catálogo primero, y cuándo y cómo escala a las fuentes extra
- [Resultados de la evaluación con LLM](https://jmrplens.github.io/libgen-mcp/es/eval-results/): Resultados de conducir un modelo real sobre MCP contra el sitio en vivo, escenario a escenario
- [Solución de problemas](https://jmrplens.github.io/libgen-mcp/es/troubleshooting/): Problemas habituales de configuración y ejecución
- [Uso responsable](https://jmrplens.github.io/libgen-mcp/es/responsible-use/): Por qué se prueban primero los proveedores de acceso abierto, y qué se niega a servir el servidor
- [Política de privacidad](https://jmrplens.github.io/libgen-mcp/es/privacy/): Sin telemetría; las peticiones van solo a los mirrors de Library Genesis y a las fuentes que invoca cada llamada
